title: RTL sheet view ods 001
notes: real ODF RTL sheet: table "RTL" is applied table:style-name="GP RTL Table", a NAMED style (style:family="table") declared in styles.xml whose style:table-properties sets table:writing-mode="rl-tb" — sheet-level RTL is per-table, not per-document. Prices are real float cells (office:value-type="float" office:value=...) whose text:p shows the number; Arabic headers المنتج/السعر with three Arabic product rows mirror the xlsx rtl-sheets content. Honest caveats: writing-mode mirrors the sheet layout (column order and scroll direction); in-cell bidi of the Arabic strings is performed by the renderer's bidi engine, not stored as layout. Reference text is the visible cell strings in row-major order; the normative counter reads table:table=1.
